title: Unbelievable experience,...
text: Unbelievable experience, something that will be remembered for a long time!! Ivy was absolutely brilliant as our host; really receptive to what we wanted from our experience, happy to go faster when desired, offered us a swim, and excellent conversation! My 12 year old son didn’t stop smiling and laughing the entire time and loved every second of it! Would recommend a million times over, and thank you so much to Ivy for being a brilliant guide!
author: Peter_H

title: We had a great time the...
text: We had a great time the young lady who took us was brilliant.  We are 70 and 74 years old and she was unsure if we would like it but we did.
author: Anne_R

title: Powerboat ride experience
text: Ivy was our driver and she did a great job despite rough conditions at sea. We got out in the open ocean for a few minutes which was like a roller coaster until we asked her to turn back. So instead we toured more parts of the harbor which was frat too!
author: Maya_L

title: Speedboat tour
text:
Amazing trip!
Ivy’s communication prior to the experience was perfect. 
Drinks were provided on arrival, and then a short tour around the harbour before we went to sea. 
There were no other guests so Ivy very kindly (we did tip) let us have a swim in the sea before heading back in. 
10/10 trip, made our visit to Barcelona.
author: 813kimberleyr

title: Great Family Time
text: This was such a fun experience! I'm glad we chose it over the larger boats. Our family had a great time and our captain Ivy was welcoming and made us feel safe and supported.  Thank you Ivy!
